rules.statement: The burden of proof regarding the termination of successive interests and any disability lies with the party claiming prescriptive possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is, in short, a question of fact wherever long continued exclusive possession by one co-owner is proved to have existed whether it is not just and reasonable in all the circumstances of the case that the parties should be treated as though it had been proved that that separate and exclusive possession had become adverse at some date more than ten years before action brought."
